title: Model Lineage Traffic Steward — compact wireflow for multi-model routing and rollback
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Prototype a compact rollout composer focused on multi-model traffic steering and per-variant lineage inspection. The flow should let engineers and PMs direct traffic across model variants (e.g., quantized / float32 / distilled), create conditional routing rules by request attributes, preview model lineage for sampled requests, and execute fast rollback at cohort or model-variant granularity. Emphasis: clear foreground actions for emergency snapback, explainable traces to audit which model served which sample, and a simulation mode that forecasts metric drift (latency, cost/unit, regression rate) before applying weights.
design_goals: Single-pane composer for traffic weights + conditional rules
Per-request lineage panel linked to telemetry samples
Simulation preview with metric delta forecast
Emergency 'snapback' CTA to instantly revert variant weights
Compact visual summary for model variants (perf/cost/last-trained)
acceptance_criteria: User can set weights across >=3 variants and add up to 4 conditional rules
Simulation shows P50/P95 latency, cost delta, and quality-regression signal for the proposed split
Lineage panel shows recent sample rows with model_variant_id, response_time, confidence_score and link to trace
Rollback action restores previous committed weights and records an audit note
Prototype has Figma screens + annotated flow for engineering handoff

notes_for_engineering: Key backend needs: model_variant_id on all request events; lineage samples endpoint; simulate endpoint that takes proposed_weights + timeframe and returns delta metrics. UI will optimistically apply slider preview locally and require explicit 'Commit' to push weights. Emergency snapback should call /rollouts/{id}/revert and write an audit note supplied by the user.
research_plan: Usability tests (remote moderated) + metrics capture: time_to_rollback, error_rate_before_after, tester_confidence_score (Likert). Run N=8 sessions; synthesize heatmaps for where people look for lineage info.
implementation_considerations: Make variant cards renderable from model-catalog metadata (name, quantization, last_evaluated), support up to 6 variants without visual overflow, accessible color palette for variant bars, and ARIA-compliant controls for sliders and tables.
